run_a2c_training: run the A2C reinforcement learning training loop for CartPole-v0 using moolib distributed training
create_Model: create a PyTorch Model with linear layers and optional LSTM for policy and baseline outputs
build_a2c_loss: build the A2C loss function computing policy gradient, baseline, and entropy losses from rollout data
review_log_to_file: review the log_to_file function that incrementally writes training metrics to a TSV file
test_create_env: test the create_env function that returns a gym CartPole-v0 environment instance
